title: Ing Miyalal a Pamuntuk ning metung a Bansa
intro: King panaun ning maragul a hamon at pangawala ning kapanayan para king metung a balen, metung a banal a pangatalaga ing megawa. Ining indibidwal a ini, a e da aintindian deng dakal, pinili ne ning Allah ban manimuna king metung a bangsa laban king metung a makatakut a kalaban. Ing karelang istorya metung yang testamento keng upaya ning kasalpantayanan ampo ing kabiasnan keng gulut ning banal a kautusan, papakit na ing tune pamanimuna e ya parating mayayakit kareng lugal a asahan.
clues: Pinili na ku ning Allah para maging lider da reng memalen ku inyang manintun lang pamuntuk para lumaban para keng keang sangkan.
Deng tau ku mumuna dang kukutnan ing kanakung appointment, pakiramdaman da na mas karapatdapat la reng aliwa pauli ning karelang pibandian o linya.
Metung a tanda ning kanakung karapatdapat a pamanimuna ya pin ing pamagbalik ning metung a sagradung kaban, a maki relikya ibat karing minunang propeta, a migdala king katahimikan.
Tinaid ku la ding sundalus ku king metung a ilug, nung nu ku sinubukan ing karelang kapamintuan king kapamilatan na ning pamagbawal karela king minum lang migit king metung a kutsarang danum.
Sumangid ning ditak la mu ding menatiling matatag kaybat ning pamagsubuk, arapan mi ya ing metung a mayupayang sundalus at ding karelang sundalus.
King lalam ning kanakung utus, metung a kayanakan a indibidwal ibat king kanakung hukbu, a e metung a sikat a talapamuk, matapang yang linaban at simbut ne ing makatakut a kalaban a kampeon.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Ing pangatalaga bilang pamuntuk laban king metung a higante
Ing albug a linub king labuad
trial.answer: Ing pangatalaga bilang pamuntuk laban king metung a higante

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Mitatag ya ing metung a kayarian a maki maragul a pibandian at upaya.
Melumud la ding tau king maragul a albug.
Ing kampeon ning kalaban mesira ya, at dininan neng Allah ing tagumpe.
Ing maragul a albug menabu ya keng gabun kilub ning dakal a banua.
Ing pekapun melaklak ne ning metung a maragul a lelangan.
outcome.answer: Ing kampeon ning kalaban mesira ya, at dininan neng Allah ing tagumpe.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
